title: Travel: John Lennon – London to Arima | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono arrived in Arima, Trinidad, on 26 April 1971.

They had left England the day before, taking an evening flight from London.

The main purpose of their visit was to see Michael X and his family. Michael X, born Michael de Freitas in Trinidad in 1933, was an activist also known as Michael Abdul Malik and Abdul Malik.

Lennon and Ono stayed in Arima until 2 May. While there, Lennon typed out the lyrics of the song ‘Imagine’ onto stationery from the hotel Hassina’s at 26 Christina Gardens in Arima. The lyrics had the postscript “March ’71, London, Madrid, Trinidad”, suggesting that the song had been worked on for several weeks.
